plan: Drive: from Northern Rockies Regional Municipality, about 258 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 59.95016, -120.46605, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 5.1 km N, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 13 m, about 103 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: no flat ground near water in the data within 1.5 km. Plan a dry camp and carry water (Tip).
Hunt: moose, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-55, Region 7B. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2020-02-25, closures 2026-10-16.

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 1.0 km and about 5 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
